description: Scrapes TikTok videos for any hashtag or keyword using apidojo's TikTok scraper on Apify. Triggers when the user asks to: get all TikTok videos for a hashtag, scrape TikTok content by topic or tag, export TikTok video data for a keyword, fetch TikTok posts under a challenge or trend, collect TikTok video metrics for a hashtag, or download TikTok video metadata by tag. Returns video URL, view count, like count, comment count, share count, author handle, caption, and timestamp per video. Ideal for trend researchers, data analysts, and social media teams.
